name: 77008 · Houston, TX
findings: ZIP 77008 (Houston) has 185 nonprofit organizations. 77 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 59 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77008 (Houston) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
39% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: 3 social and fraternal organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 10 would.
